port.description: TCP port number for the SKK dictionary server to listen on (standard SKK port is 1178).

bind.description: IP address to bind the server to. Use '127.0.0.1' to restrict to local connections, or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces.

dict_file.description: Path to the primary SKK dictionary CDB file (e.g., SKK-JISYO.L.cdb).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections the server will accept.

verbose.description: If enabled, logs request details and errors to stdout/stderr for debugging.

tcp_nodelay.description: If enabled, disables Nagle's algorithm to reduce latency for small packets (recommended for interactive dictionary lookups).

chroot_dir.description: Directory to chroot into for security. Leave empty to disable chrooting.

user.description: System user to drop privileges to after starting the server (must exist).

group.description: System group to drop privileges to after starting the server (must exist).

pid_file.description: Path for the PID file. Set to empty string to avoid creating a PID file.

extra_dicts.description: List of additional CDB dictionary files to include for fallback lookups (processed in order).

items.description: Path to a valid CDB dictionary file (e.g., '/var/lib/dbskkd-cdb/SKK-JISYO.JA.cdb').

timeout.description: Idle connection timeout in seconds. Set to 0 to disable timeouts.

ipv6.description: Enable listening on IPv6 addresses in addition to IPv4.

backlog.description: Socket listen backlog size (depth of pending connection queue).
